isolation.network: shared network; test API uses loopback only; all SSH/transfer commands are local shims
isolation.ssh: local command shims; no SSH server or remote host contacted
isolation.model: scripted Anthropic API responses; no live or paid model calls

limitations: SSH and transfer commands were local shims; no actual remote host login or GPU scheduling was tested.
Anthropic API responses were scripted; no real DeepSeek, Qwen or paid Claude inference was requested.
Direct SSH jobs are not enrolled in the managed compute executor lifecycle. Local worktree verification alone does not attest to remote changes.
The first harness run had a malformed fixture command; it failed independent verification and was preserved. A corrected harness ran in a fresh workspace.
This host did not allow loopback setup in a private network namespace. Filesystem/PID isolation was retained with shared networking; only a loopback mock API was contacted.
